leadText:
(Japanese: マンプゥクタウン Manpūku Town) is an -exclusive town located in Paldea. It was not given a name in the English dub.

 is a local street artist here known among the residents. He is known to make paintings with his in the shopping district, offering passersby to paint them something. He lives in a treehouse just outside of the town.

An Explorers base is located not far from the town.
